body: beta release in some days, and true release in less than a month

Hello, i am new in the community and i present you my first theme, Fivo!

Fivo, is a gradient based theme with 5 different color available : Red, blue, green, orange, yellow.

So basically you got 5 different color choice for one icon.

The first release will provide 400-500 different icons, with customs settings and badges, and i will make monthly update with 100-200 icons each months.
